The R&D amortization requirement for domestic and foreign R&D expenses persisted through much of 2024-2025 before eventually being addressed in later tax legislation, consistent with ongoing financial strain during the interim period.

Neither a full rollback of R&D amortization rules nor major antitrust/M&A easing was comprehensively achieved in the years immediately following, though some relief measures were eventually enacted; the broader startup-failure impact is difficult to isolate and quantify.
